# NuxtBeyond - AI-First Nuxt 4 Boilerplate

> Free, open-source (MIT) Nuxt 4 boilerplate for AI-powered SaaS: AI chat with RAG, embeddable chat widget, AI image and video generation, authentication, Stripe or Polar billing, and Cloudflare deployment. nuxtbeyond.com is the project's website and hosted demo. The code is on GitHub.

## Overview

NuxtBeyond is a free, open-source Nuxt 4 boilerplate released under the MIT License. The full source code is at https://github.com/BeyondFolder/nuxt-beyond. Fork it, modify it, and use it for personal or commercial projects. There is nothing to buy. The services you connect (Cloudflare, OpenAI, Stripe or Polar, Resend) bill you under their own pricing.

It ships as a working multi-tenant SaaS (an AI support chatbot with a knowledge base) that you can rebrand, extend, or strip down.

## Key Features

- **AI Chat with RAG**: Streaming responses with Vercel AI SDK v6, OpenAI models via Cloudflare AI Gateway, knowledge base search with Cloudflare AI Search (AutoRAG)
- **Embeddable Widget**: One-line script that adds a chat bubble to allowed domains
- **Human Support Escalation**: The AI can hand a conversation to your team; answered questions can be added back to the knowledge base (self learning)
- **AI Image Generation**: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT Image (`gpt-image-2.6-flare`)
- **AI Video Generation (optional)**: Text or image to video, plus follow-up edits, with Google Gemini Omni Flash; needs a paid-tier `GEMINI_API_KEY`
- **Authentication**: Google OAuth and email/password with nuxt-auth-utils, email verification, password reset
- **Billing**: Stripe or Polar subscriptions (selected with `PAYMENT_PROVIDER`), checkout, customer portal, webhooks, plan-based feature limits
- **Multi-tenant Projects**: Role-based access (admin/member) and email invitations
- **Email**: Transactional emails with Resend

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Nuxt 4, Vue 3, TypeScript
- **UI**: Nuxt UI v4, Tailwind CSS, dark mode
- **AI**: Vercel AI SDK v6, OpenAI via Cloudflare AI Gateway, Cloudflare AI Search, Workers AI
- **Database**: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) with Drizzle ORM
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2 via NuxtHub
- **Deployment**: Cloudflare Workers, with `npm run deploy` (Wrangler) or Cloudflare Workers Builds

## Project Structure

- `app/` - Pages, layouts, components, composables
- `server/` - API routes, database schema and queries, utilities
- `shared/` - Shared types and constants (plan limits in `shared/constants.ts`)
- `content/` - Landing page, blog, and legal pages (Nuxt Content)

## Sample Plans

The repo includes three sample plans (Free, Pro, Advanced) to demonstrate plan-based feature gating. They are examples for your own product, not a price for NuxtBeyond. Limits live in `shared/constants.ts`, and paid plans are billed monthly per project.

- **Free**: 5 documents (0.1MB each), 200 AI replies/month
- **Pro**: 50 documents (2MB each), 5,000 AI replies/month, human support escalation, self learning, 7-day free trial for new Stripe customers
- **Advanced**: 100 documents (4MB each), 10,000 AI replies/month, human support escalation, self learning

## Hosted Demo

Try the app at https://nuxtbeyond.com/login with the demo admin or member account shown on the login page. The demo runs the real dashboard, AI chat, image and video generation, and support chatbot, with shared daily limits on AI usage. Sign-up, Google sign-in, checkout, uploads, and project or team changes are turned off.

## Development

```bash
npm install          # Install dependencies
npm run dev          # Start dev server
npm run build        # Build for production
npm run db:generate  # Generate database migrations
npm run typecheck    # Type checking
npm run lint         # Linting
npm run deploy       # Deploy to Cloudflare Workers (Wrangler)
```

## Use Cases

- AI chatbot and customer support SaaS
- Multi-tenant SaaS products
- AI image and video generation tools
- AI-powered tools and utilities
